plot: Two days before the science fair Mia's clay volcano won't erupt and she wants to stay home; Zeek blames the vinegar (Bup's sniff says it's sour) and then the clay (Crispy dries it), Bup's shaking and Pim's pep talk do nothing, until Lolly tastes the powder — the twist: it's powdered sugar, because helpful Pim filled the jar from the big white bag (he bragged about it at the start); the bros push the real orange baking-soda box next to the volcano, Mia figures it out, the eruption foams over everyone and she wins a blue ribbon — then Dad announces the holiday-card family photo on Sunday, and Bup wonders if 'everybody' means them too.

beats.say: She poured the vinegar and... nothing! Not even one bubble!
Why won't Mia's volcano erupt? The science fair is Friday!
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Wednesday afternoon. Mia's clay volcano sits on the kitchen table.
Mia tried three times. Then she went upstairs and shut her door.
And I helped, you know! I filled her powder jar this morning!
From the big white bag on the bottom shelf. All by myself!
A volcano! Finally, real science in this kitchen!
Baking soda plus vinegar makes gas. Gas makes foam. Foam goes up.
Then why didn't it go up, professor?
Simple. Bad vinegar. Old vinegar loses its sour.
Bup sniffs the vinegar bottle. His eyes water. His crust curls.
Not old. Very, very sour. My nose is still crying.
Then it's the clay. Wet clay soaks up the bubbles.
Crispy warms the clay all over. It dries hard. Still no bubbles.
Dry as a desert. And not a single fizz.
Mia said if it fails, she won't go to the fair.
Then we shake it. Real volcanoes shake. I've seen pictures.
Bup hugs the volcano and shakes. The whole table wobbles. Nothing.
Maybe it's shy. Maybe it needs a little pep talk.
Hey, volcano. You can do this. Erupt. Please. For Mia.
The volcano says nothing. Volcanoes rarely do.
I don't understand. My science never fails. Except... often.
Thursday. Mia comes down with her poster. Her eyes are red.
She whispers into the walkie. Maybe I'm just bad at science.
No. That girl is not bad at science. I won't allow it.
Tomorrow morning that volcano goes to school. Tonight it erupts.
Let's test every part. Vinegar, fine. Clay, fine. That leaves the powder.
Lolly walks to the powder jar. She dips one point in. Tastes.
Wait. This is sweet. Soft, sweet, and melty.
I'm a cookie. I know this taste. That's powdered sugar!
The big white bag... Oh no. I filled her jar with sugar.
I only wanted to help. And I broke her volcano.
You helped with the wrong bag. That's not breaking. That's Wednesday.
Every bag in this house is white. Nobody could tell.
Real baking soda comes in the orange box. Behind the flour!
Thursday night. Five bros push an orange box across the counter.
Let me push the hardest. It was my mess. It's my push.
Mia comes down for water. She sees the orange box. She stops.
She reads the box. Looks at her jar. Licks a finger.
She's working it out. Smart girl.
Mia pours in the soda. Then the vinegar. One second. Two.
Whoosh! Foam pours out. Over the table. Over every bro.
I'm covered in volcano! Is this how I go? Foamy?
Science! Real science! It works when you use the right bag!
And Pim's sugar isn't wasted. It's going on Mia's pancakes.
Friday. Mia wins a blue ribbon. She tapes it to our basket.
My first ribbon. Well, Mia's. But I touched it.
Then Dad walks in with a camera and a tripod.
Family photo for the holiday card. Sunday, in the garden. Everybody smiles.
Everybody? Does everybody mean us too?
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

"Je voulais juste aider. Et j'ai cassé son volcan." — Pim

#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

「ただ手伝いたかっただけなのに。ミアの火山をダメにしちゃった。」— ピム
科学フェアまであと2日。ミアの粘土の火山は泡ひとつ出ない。ドウ・ブロスは酢、粘土、そして自分たちの忍耐を試す——ロリーが粉をなめるまでは。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

"그냥 돕고 싶었어. 근데 미아 화산을 망쳐 버렸어." — 핌
과학 박람회 이틀 전, 미아의 점토 화산은 거품 하나 안 나요. 도우 브로스는 식초와 점토, 그리고 인내심을 시험하는데… 롤리가 가루를 맛보기 전까지는요.
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros
